title: Mistral’s new 1T model aims to leapfrog closed and open rivals
slides: Can Mistral's 1T model actually beat closed rivals?
It's open-weight, unlike GPT-4 or Claude.
But raw scale often hides serving costs.
Your inference bill may drop or spike.
Test it on your hardest query before believing hype.
thread_text:
1. Open-weight giant

Mistral's 1T parameter model just dropped, and it's open-weight. That means you can download it, but can it actually compete with GPT-4 and Claude?

2. Freedom to tweak

Unlike closed rivals, you can fine-tune and self-host. No API lock-in, but you'll need serious hardware to run it.

3. Scale isn't free

The 1T size balloons serving costs. Inference could get pricey fast, even if the weights are free.

4. Your bill, your call

Depending on your setup, costs might drop or spike. Benchmark against your current stack before switching.

5. Test before trust

Take your hardest query and run it on Mistral. If it doesn't beat your current model, the hype isn't worth it.

instagram.caption:
Mistral's new model packs 1 trillion parameters and you can download the weights for free.

Open-weight means you can fine-tune it and skip API lock-in entirely. Unlike GPT-4 or Claude, nobody can shut off your access. 🧠

But 1T parameters mean serious hardware to self-host, and your inference bill could swing either way. 💸

If you build or publish with AI, benchmark this against your current stack before switching anything.

Run your hardest query on it first. If it doesn't beat what you already use, the hype isn't worth it. 🔍
